{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsorfield shell''' was created by [[repulsor beam]]s focused through [[repulsor beam projector]]s. The shells surrounded [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] colonies in the [[Roche asteroid field]]. When two colonies came within range of each other, their shells interacted and pushed the asteroids away from each other.<ref name="SFS">''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]''</ref>
